mapper.sql: a.id, a.tenant_id, a.scene_id, a.variable_id, a.created_time, a.status_cd, a.updated_time, a.creator_id, a.updator_id, a.remark
mapper.select: SELECT , b.variable_name, b.variable_code FROM bt_claw_env_variable a LEFT JOIN bt_env_variable b ON a.variable_id = b.variable_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.created_time
